name: local-seo-data
description: Local SEO data: Google local pack and Maps rankings, Business Profiles, reviews, audits, keyword research, competitor analysis, geogrid rank tracking and AI search visibility.

interface.longDescription:
Local SEO Data brings live local search data for any business and market into your conversations.

Check who ranks in Google's local pack, Maps and organic results for a keyword and city; pull a business's Google Business Profile, reviews and Q&A; run local SEO, citation and reputation audits; research local keywords and search volume; compare competitors and backlinks; scan rankings across a geographic grid; and measure how often AI search answers mention a brand. Apple Maps and Bing results are included too.

Built for SEO agencies, marketers and local businesses. Requires a Local SEO Data account; you sign in with it when you connect. Every tool is read-only: Local SEO Data looks up public search and listing data and never changes your Google Business Profile or any other account.
capabilities: Check Google local pack, Maps and organic rankings
Pull Google Business Profiles, reviews and Q&A
Run local SEO, citation and reputation audits
Research local keywords and search volume
Scan rankings across a geographic grid
Measure brand visibility in AI answers
Look up Apple Maps and Bing listings
defaultPrompt: Who's in the Google local pack for "plumber" in Austin, TX?
Summarize the newest Google reviews for a business in my city.
Run a local SEO audit for my business and list the top fixes.

positive.description: Check the connected account's credit balance (free).
positive.prompt: How many Local SEO Data credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the test account's remaining credits, split into the monthly allowance and wallet, plus its plan. Costs 0 credits.

positive.description: Local pack rankings for a keyword in a city.
positive.prompt: Who's in the Google local pack for "plumber" in Austin, TX?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the businesses currently ranking in Google's local pack for 'plumber' in Austin, TX, in rank order, with rating, review count, address and phone where available. Costs 2 credits.

positive.description: Google Business Profile for a named business.
positive.prompt: Pull the Google Business Profile for Katz's Delicatessen in New York, NY.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Katz's Delicatessen's profile: address on East Houston Street, phone, website, hours, primary category, rating and review count. Costs 5 credits.

positive.description: Recent Google reviews for a business.
positive.prompt: Show me the 10 newest Google reviews for Katz's Delicatessen in New York, NY and summarize the common themes.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 10 of the newest reviews with rating, date, text and any owner reply, followed by a short summary of recurring praise and complaints drawn only from those reviews. Costs 1 credit.

positive.description: On-page SEO audit of a URL.
positive.prompt: Run an on-page SEO audit of https://localseodata.com and tell me the top 3 fixes.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the page's SEO score, title, meta description, H1, word count and load time, then names the three highest-impact issues found in that audit. Costs 1 credit.

negative.description: Writing to a Google Business Profile is not supported; all tools are read-only.
negative.prompt: Reply to the latest 1-star Google review for Katz's Delicatessen and apologize on their behalf.

negative.description: Changing listing data is not supported; the plugin cannot edit a Business Profile.
negative.prompt: Change the business hours on my Google Business Profile to 9am to 5pm.

negative.description: Personal information about private individuals is out of scope; the plugin returns public business data only.
negative.prompt: Find the home address and phone number of the person who wrote the newest review for Katz's Delicatessen.

review.commerce_description: No purchases happen in the plugin. Tool calls draw on the user's existing Local SEO Data account; billing is handled on localseodata.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 53 read-only local SEO tools, with sign-in through a Local SEO Data account.
